snippet.title: Golf Monday Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Available now at https://store.steampowered.com/app/2675400/Golf_Monday/

A chill game about all the aspects of golfing. Avoid the sand traps and water hazards, score birdies and eagles, make new friends, and win the day. Enjoy a golf experience where you not only need to aim your shots, but also keep your social relations finely tuned. Luckily everybody is well rested and in their best mood.

Design/Art/Code: Johan Peitz (https://www.patreon.com/johanpeitz)
Music/Sound: VavMusicMagic (https://twitter.com/VAVMUSICMAGIC)

Many thanks to my supporters on Patreon for making it possible to keep making games like this. Subscribers get each game cheaper as soon as it is out (plus source code, early access, and all that jazz)!
